latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of podcast-transcript-mining-authority-positioning.
- Extracts guest appearances, key speaking topics, and soundbites from podcast transcripts.
- Automates building authority portfolios and generates personalized podcast pitch templates.
- Integrates with Slack, Google Search, WordPress, and Zapier; requires relevant API keys.
- Supports multi-format content repurposing across LinkedIn, Twitter, blog, email, and video scripts.
- Enables competitor analysis and identifies untapped podcast guesting opportunities.
